title: What Do We Lose By Believing In God

top_liked.author: @DeanKruger
top_liked.text: Time, money, autonomy. Love your work, D.

top_liked.author: @BubbaF0wpend
top_liked.text:
Thinking of the overwhelming and unnecessary waste always gets me

The time wasted praying and practicing it... how many sundays and other times are wasted, so many other better things could be done with this time

The waste of effort, how much further along could we be along as…
